candidates.policy: Keep the replaced card in encounter-scoped DISCARD during Battle, then shuffle it with active Monster cards into the deck at Battle End.
candidates.consequence: All cards drawn for that Battle are available to later ordinary encounters; the replacement card cannot be drawn or summoned while Battle is active.

candidates.policy: Keep the replaced card discarded for the current Dungeon run.
candidates.consequence: The Monster deck depletes more quickly and future encounters have a changed composition.

candidates.policy: Return the replaced card immediately before Battle initialization.
candidates.consequence: The card could be drawn again by another setup step; it introduces an extra shuffle/RNG event absent from the printed setup.

rationale: An encounter-scoped discard preserves the explicit p17 discard through the whole Battle, then uses the existing p25 end-of-Battle shuffle boundary without introducing an extra random operation. This is a digital lifecycle choice, not an official rule claim.
ownershipTransition: ENCOUNTER -> DISCARD on replacement; DISCARD -> DECK only in the idempotent Battle End return transaction
saveReplayImpact: v5 saves persist every physical copy owner, replacement event, RNG cursor and rule version. Reload before or after Battle End produces the same card ownership and shuffle. v1-v4 records retain their prior semantics and are not migrated in place.
